name: the defaults: 20 calls at 0.5% slow leave 9.54% of requests slow, and each call needs p99.95

fields.label: Requests that wait for a slow call

parts.text: 1 - (1 - 0.5%)^20  ·  a p99 target allows 1%
For p99 on the request, each call needs p99.95. Your calls are at p99.5.

fields.label: Assumes
fields.value: Calls are slow independently of each other, and the request waits for all of them. Calls that share a host, a network path or a pause are slow together, so measure your own requests and use this as the baseline.

fields.label: How it is worked out
fields.value: A request is fast only if every call is. With n calls, each slow a share q of the time, 1 - (1 - q)^n of requests are slow. For a share p of requests to be fast, each call must be fast with probability p^(1/n), which is the percentile it needs.
